summary_en: 3,000,000 ordinary shares to be cancelled effective 2026-07-31. Issued shares outstanding to fall from 46,613,500 to 43,613,500 (6.4% reduction). Treasury share count to decline from 5,972,067 to approximately 2,882,736 shares.
title_en: Notice Regarding Cancellation of Treasury Shares
translation_en_brief: On 24 July 2026, the board of directors of ナック (Nack Co., Ltd., TSE Prime listing, code 9788) resolved to cancel 3,000,000 ordinary treasury shares pursuant to Article 178 of the Companies Act. The cancellation is scheduled for 31 July 2026. As of 30 June 2026, the company held 5,972,067 treasury shares out of 46,613,500 issued shares (12.8% of issued total). Upon completion of the cancellation, issued shares will total 43,613,500, and treasury holdings are expected to fall to approximately 2,882,736 shares (representing 6.6% of the post-cancellation issued total). The figure reflects the impact of restricted-stock awards of 89,331 shares processed on 24 July 2026, and does not include fractional-share acquisitions from 1 July 2026 onward.
